model.backend: Upstream PolyNoteDetector and embedded PolyNoteModel, native CPU
model.checkpoint_provenance: Embedded model at the pinned public revision; no retraining or model modification. Training overlap with these recordings not established.

protocol.input: Pinned mono WAV, native 96000 Hz float32, fixed -9 dB input trim matching saved CURRENT. Block 512, no resampling, no EOF padding.
protocol.detector: PolyNoteDetector Prepare(rate, poly_note_model::Model()); unchanged trained Settings{}; threshold -50 dB, lowest note 35, follow pitch false. Lowest 35 is the detector/reference-test default; GUI host default is 38 (Drop D), so this is explicitly the full model range, not host-default equivalence.
protocol.time: Actual emitted input sample = block start + event.sampleOffset. No backdating, nominal-clock correction or fitted shift. Open notes at EOF contribute only through the recording end; no synthetic note-offs.
protocol.labels: Scoring only after detector exits and events are saved. No relabeling or exclusion; ALL annotations remain denominators, including notes outside 35..88.
protocol.comparison: Distinct pitch occupancy, no string assignments or unison multiplicity. Same-pitch overlap/touch union for both detectors. Saved CURRENT measurement must reproduce exactly.
protocol.primary: range_preserving: CURRENT spans outside 35..88 plus Soundshed spans inside 35..88. Ordinary pitch-coverage gain >=5 percentage points; both corpora no wrong-pitch or gap-output growth, no all-expected/exact-set duration loss. Strict per-label zero-loss reported separately from frozen budget: present and longest loss <=25 ms AND <=5% of own CURRENT value; no newly entirely missed label.
protocol.report_only: Soundshed alone; literal CURRENT union Soundshed; fixed split CURRENT<60 plus Soundshed>=60. Full per-label rows and first-present delay retained even on rejection. No combined implementation or promotion.
protocol.reference_gates: Compile and execute the complete unchanged pinned upstream PolyNoteDetectorTests.cpp first. Every reported check must pass before adapter compilation or corpus replay. Source/weights each checked against pinned Git blob SHA-1 and bytes; SHA-256 receipts retained.
protocol.timing: Native Process plus preallocated event sink, measured once at block512 on each corpus; excludes file I/O and preparation. Report p50/p95/p99/max and actual callback-deadline overruns, plus existing M3 limits p99<=166666 ns, max<=333333 ns. Zero allocations not measured; timing is separate from pitch screen and does not establish live/host acceptance.
protocol.baseline_configuration: Saved collision-enabled CURRENT at block512, A4=440, trim=-9, sensitivity60, response75, maxpoly5, maxfret24. Independently configured from the upstream model defaults; not a controlled production-policy comparison.
protocol.failure_rule: One fixed configuration and one dispatch. Scientific rejection closes this screen without tuning or rerun. Harness failure yields no scientific verdict.
